ITINERARY

The trip rhythm.
Every Saturday.

Next: upcoming departure. Saturday leave. Exact Spiti loop (via Manali or Shimla side) flexes for snow, slides and permits.

Download itinerary PDF Day-by-day outline — ready to share.

  1. Depart Saturday · Toward high roads

    • Saturday evening leave from Jaipur or Delhi NCR.
    • Multi-day approach via Himachal high roads (route confirmed by host).
    • Acclimatisation nights built into the 7N plan.

  2. Circuit · Kaza & monasteries

    • Kaza base days for Key, Chicham, Langza / Hikkim / Komic as roads allow.
    • Altitude rest, hydration and early nights.
    • Local cafés and monastery visits with the group.

  3. Scenic days · Gorges & villages

    • Dhankar / Pin Valley / lake viewpoints depending on seasonal access.
    • Host may reshuffle for landslides or snow.
    • Photography stops are frequent — stay with vehicle meet times.

  4. Return · Long descent

    • Exit Spiti on the open corridor that week.
    • Long return toward Delhi NCR with overnight segments.
    • Arrival windows are wide — Spiti exits are never minute-fixed.

ALONG THE WAY

High-desert icons & flex stops.

Kaza and Key are core. Remote villages and passes depend on the week's road status.

Kaza

Circuit hub — markets and stay base.

Key Monastery

Cliffside monastery — trip icon.

Chicham Bridge

Gorge viewpoint when open.

Langza / Hikkim

High villages — weather dependent.

Dhankar

Ridge monastery above the confluence.

Kunzum / high passes

Only when the corridor is officially open.

BEFORE YOU JOIN

Included & not promised.

Long-circuit coach, stay nights and core monastery days are planned. Remote passes are never guaranteed.

Included

  • Breakfast and dinner
  • Shared coach / Tempo Traveller class vehicle
  • Jaipur or Delhi NCR pickup coordination
  • Spiti-circuit stay nights as per host route

Not promised

  • Every high village in deep winter
  • Open Kunzum / shortcut passes every week
  • Oxygen / medical facilities at every stop
  • Fixed return day-to-the-hour

Good to know

Altitude first.

Diamox only if your doctor advises — hydrate and report symptoms early.

Cold dry air.

Lip balm, sunscreen, warm layers — Spiti sun is sharp.

Roads rule.

Landslides and snow rewrite the map; trust the host reshuffle.
